images.caption: The Simpson Street (IRT White Plains Road) elevated station was built in 1904 and opened on November 26, 1904. It is located at the Junction of Westchester Ave., between Simpson St. and Southern Blvd. in the Bronx, New York. It was listed in the National Register of Historic Places on September 17, 2004. Line station house as viewed from street-level.
